description: This file declares the interface IServerFactory for creating IPC server instances within the Rialto project. It includes a factory method to create server objects and manages dependencies on the IIpcServer interface.

classes.name: IServerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating IPC server instances, providing a static factory method and a virtual create method.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IServerFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IServer object.
